name: footer-bold
title: Footer Bold
blurb: Full-width footer with bold typography, watermark, and contact sections.
description: A landing-page footer with a large background text watermark, contact CTA with email link, location and social media sections, and a minimalist bottom bar. Spans full viewport height.
use_when: Showcasing a striking brand presence at the end of portfolio or product pages.
avoid_when: On pages with limited vertical space or mobile-first designs requiring compact footers.
a11y: Uses semantic `<footer>` and `<address>` elements. All links keyboard-accessible. Watermark text is non-interactive and has `pointer-events-none`.
